LORELINKS.Unresolved: No note named "{name}" yet. Click to create it.
LORELINKS.CannotCreate: No note named "{name}" exists, and you are not allowed to create journal entries.

RenameLinks.Name: Update links when renaming
RenameLinks.Hint: When a journal entry, page, actor or item is renamed, rewrite the [[links]] that point to it so they keep working.

Rename.Title: Update links?
Rename.Prompt: "{old}" was renamed to "{new}". Update {count} link(s) in {sources} document(s) so they keep pointing to it?
Rename.Skipped: {count} text field(s) were not updated because you do not own them.
Rename.NoPermission: Links to "{name}" were not updated because you do not own the documents that contain them.

Export.Title: Export to Obsidian
Export.Hint: Download a zip of your journal as an Obsidian vault: one Markdown file per note, with [[links]] that keep working in Obsidian. Unzip it and open the folder as a vault.
Export.MissingImages: {count} image(s) could not be copied and were left out.

Import.Title: Import from Obsidian
Import.Hint: Choose an Obsidian vault folder, or individual Markdown files and the images they embed. Each note becomes a journal entry; images are uploaded to the world.
Import.KeepFolders: Recreate the vault's folders as journal folders
Import.Update: Update notes that already exist instead of creating copies
Import.Done: Imported notes: {created} created, {updated} updated. {images} image(s) uploaded.
Import.Skipped: {skipped} actor or item note(s) were skipped; only journal notes are imported.
